checkpoint.title: Route 3 and 4 to the Magikarp salesman
notes: Route 3's north exit (x 68..75) joins Route 4 (offset 60) at x 8..15, up which column 12 leads to the Pokemon Center's door (12, 5). Lass Robin (40, 11) wanders up and down at x 40, looking north and south, sight 3. Rock above (y <= 8) and grass below (y >= 12) leave every way east across her column at y 9..11, so whether she sees the player depends on her facing. The walk watches for her after the leg along row 9, which crosses her sight on (40, 9) only; if she saw the player, her message goes to story_interrupts(), which fight her, and the route goes on from (40, 9) (run_route(); console B, 2026-11-02, she stopped the player there and spoke after the leg's short watch).
